svg.text: village turtle on fairly flat ground
wireless modem (for storage or a crew)
optional: full-block wired modem on the
supply chest, cable back to the storage system
• The village spreads out round this spot (radius 48 by default).
• Fill the supply chest with the theme's blocks and coal ('village list medieval'), or let the storage system send them.
• Needs GPS (a modem on the turtle).
